supersedes: scripts/hfref_quarantine_primary.R (single-trial quarantine, quarantined fit presented alone)
settled_source_mode: READ-ONLY; prefix evaluated, RUN/EMIT never reached

presentation.direction_flag: Removing these unverified identical-count trials moves every retained treatment node's POINT ESTIMATE away from the null (median -2.13%). That is the direction the gate warned about and it is real: it must not be read as benefit. But INTERVAL significance FALLS, not rises -- on the 91 pairs both fits estimate, CI-excludes-1 goes 12 -> 9 (0 gain, 3 lose), because tau2 rises +8.2%, I2 goes 57.3% -> 63.8%, HKSJ df falls 15 -> 12 and CIs widen (median +9.36%). Neither reading makes the quarantined fit stronger evidence. It is a PROVENANCE SENSITIVITY. The full-network fit is the conservative co-primary and must be shown alongside it.

direction_detail.note: The single-trial (CARMEN-only) re-fit this supersedes reported CI-excludes-1 rising 12 -> 17. That rise was an artefact of the ASYMMETRIC quarantine: with GALACTIC-HF and Vizzardi 2014 also withheld, the added heterogeneity and lost df outweigh it and the count falls instead.

quarantine.rule: unverified per-arm all-cause deaths AND identical across-arm counts

violations.HF-021: unverified per-arm all-cause deaths (14/14/14) identical across all three arms; primary endpoint is LVESVI and the source reports no deaths
violations.HF-034: unverified per-arm all-cause deaths (1078/1078) identical across both arms; the source states CARDIOVASCULAR death (808/798), not all-cause
violations.HF-025: unverified per-arm all-cause deaths (8/8) identical across both arms; the source reports only composite event-free survival
